ck_enabled_link_has_target.name: ck_enabled_link_has_target
ck_enabled_link_has_target.value: NOT is_enabled OR link_type = 'GOOGLE_REVIEW' OR url IS NOT NULL OR phone IS NOT NULL

ck_alias_has_expiry.name: ck_alias_has_expiry
ck_alias_has_expiry.value: is_primary OR redirect_until IS NOT NULL

ck_subscription_period_pair.name: ck_subscription_period_pair
ck_subscription_period_pair.value: (starts_at IS NULL AND expires_at IS NULL) OR (starts_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at IS NOT NULL)

ck_subscription_period_order.name: ck_subscription_period_order
ck_subscription_period_order.value: starts_at IS NULL OR expires_at IS NULL OR starts_at < expires_at

ck_paid_status_has_period.name: ck_paid_status_has_period
ck_paid_status_has_period.value: status NOT IN ('PRO_ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE') OR (starts_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at IS NOT NULL)
